title: AnalystCoverageRegistrySchema
description: Schema for the per-company analyst and firm coverage registry. Aggregates all known sell-side research coverage relationships, tracking which firms and analysts actively cover each equity in the universe.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the covered equity.

covering_firms.description: Array of sell-side research firms and their lead analysts covering this equity.

firm.description: Name of the sell-side research firm or investment bank.

lead_analyst.description: Name of the lead research analyst at the firm covering this equity.

coverage_type.description: Current status of the firm's coverage on this equity.

latest_rating.description: Most recent standardized rating action from this firm.

latest_target_price.description: Most recent price target from this firm in USD.

latest_date.description: Date of the most recent report from this firm (YYYY-MM-DD).

total_reports.description: Total number of reports/revisions recorded from this firm for this equity.

ir_page_listed.description: Whether this firm is listed on the company's investor relations analyst coverage page.

firm_research_url.description: URL to the firm's public research portal or analyst bio page.

total_covering_firms.description: Total number of distinct sell-side firms with active coverage.

total_reports.description: Total number of individual analyst reports recorded.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this registry entry was last rebuilt.
